title: State of A.P. v. McDowell & Co.

content.caseIdentity: State of A.P. v. McDowell & Co., (1996) 3 SCC 709
content.holding: An enactment can be struck down only for lack of legislative competence or violation of Fundamental Rights; no statute can be struck down on grounds of legislative mala fides.
content.relevance: Absolute judicial refusal to entertain legislative mala fides.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (1996) 3 SCC 709; 1996 INSC 490; 1996 Supp (1) SCR 721; grounds for challenging parliamentary and state legislation.
